concepts.name: 星河琉璃
concepts.direction: Indigo, jade glaze, ivory and brass; elevated starlit night market, curved glazed eaves, octagonal palace lanterns and restrained constellation details.
components: New mountain terrace, sky, bridge and distant night market
Blue-jade glazed curved roof and indigo/brass fascia
Matching pair of warm octagonal glass lanterns
Indigo chef apron
Matching round wood stools with pale glazed seats
Indigo constellation-border tablecloth
Jade constellation plant pot
Indigo star-topped menu stand
Scalloped ivory/jade/gold star-pattern plate
Dark iron wok with coordinated indigo/brass handle

concepts.name: 柿灯丰年
concepts.direction: Persimmon orange, oatmeal linen, leaf green and warm wood; autumn village night market and handcrafted woven canopy.
components: New autumn mountain village, stone lanes, persimmon tree and market
Woven arched bamboo/reed canopy with embroidered linen valance
Matching pair of persimmon-shaped warm lanterns
Oatmeal/terracotta chef apron with leaf-green straps
Matching square wood stools with woven seat pads
Oatmeal tablecloth with terracotta border and persimmon embroidery
Cream ceramic pot with leaf lip and persimmon motif
Warm wood calyx-topped menu stand
Soft-square ivory serving plate with leaf-green edge
Dark iron wok with wrapped warm handle and brass loop

visualReview: Both concepts include a complete large hero scene and four readable detail studies.
Environment, roof silhouette, lamps, apron, stools, pot, menu, plate and wok details differ visibly from the baseline.
Hero props and lower studies share matching shapes, colors and motifs.
Both lamps, both stools and the left ingredient prep rack are present.
Food colors, cream chef clothing, friendly face and warm night-market illumination are retained.
Plate shapes and rim decoration are visible at large scale in the detail strip.
Tablecloths cover the tabletop corner and front rim in the furnishing study.
These boards are art direction, not separated transparent assets or evidence of gameplay integration.
No purchase rules, unlock thresholds, economy or save data were changed.
